judgement.reason: Laravel invoicing app with MySQL/PostgreSQL and S3 support; the s6 supervisor split into web and worker is a contained change.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported container setup: docker/production/Dockerfile runs s6-overlay with a web server and a worker service (scheduler) in one container. Deployz runs one web process and declared workers as separate services.
reviews.reason: The shown lines do not prove the bundled scheduler is disabled in production; the compose comment only describes an option, and a comment is not proof.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unconfirmed service: the repository declares database (mariadb:10) in docker/production/docker-compose.mysql.yml. Deployz did not find how the application uses it.
reviews.reason: The declared service is a MariaDB/MySQL database that the app selects through DB_CONNECTION, and Deployz provides managed MySQL for it.
